topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: When my neighbor knocked on the door, I had a sudden urge to check the mail or tidy up the living room, anything but answer. But there she stood, sunlight behind her, casting a long shadow into the hallway. She mentioned, almost apologetically, how the pandemic had sparked her interest in gardening, and her yard, being mostly shaded, wasn’t ideal. She wondered, she said, trailing off, if a small corner of my yard might be available for a little plot. I nodded, finding my voice a bit croaky, and agreed, but inside, thoughts raced about boundaries and sunlight and what this commitment might mean. I managed a smile and invited her to look at the yard, hoping it would suit her needs.
